questions.stem: A 7-year-old boy is brought to the pediatrician's office by his mother, who is concerned about her son's behavior. She reports that he has been having difficulty concentrating at school, often interrupts others, and is consistently disorganized. The boy's teacher has also noticed these behaviors and has expressed concern about his academic performance. The symptoms have persisted for more than 6 months and began before he turned 6 years old. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis for this patient?
